g.text: Drawing MFG-DRV-03 | Part DRV-03 — M3 Z16 keyed phase gear lamination | Qty 6
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: 6 mm S45C | Process/finish: waterjet/wire-EDM profile + stack dowel/finish
Overall: X 53.996 × Y 6.000 × Z 53.996 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: M3 Z16 20 degree; bore Ø20.2 +0.05/0; internal 6.2 wide x6 radial keyway; 2xM4 clearance Ø4.5 + 1xØ3 H7 dowel on PCD30 at 0/120/240
degree; three laminations per gear; stack face >=18; key transmits shaft torque
GD&T/datums: A=shaft bore axis; B=stack face; C=key/dowel angular datum; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; CMM centre distance; blue-check backlash/contact;
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Release: PASS — physical validation NOT_RUN; procurement and machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
